summary: Nicola Mining Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice and information circular for its annual general and special meeting scheduled for August 5, 2026. The meeting covers standard routine items: receiving audited financials, setting director count at five, electing directors (Peter Espig, Frank Hogel, Paul Johnston, Malcolm Swallow, Brent Omland), appointing Davidson Company LLP as auditors, and re-approving the 2022 Equity Incentive Plan with a 10% rolling option plan and fixed 14,587,604 share performance-based award pool. This is a routine governance filing—not a special situation.
